name: Morse.closedRiemBall
difference: For r < 0 the project reads ρ(p,x) ≤ ofReal r = 0, so its ball is {p} (for p ∈ N), while the blind reads ρ(p,x).toReal ≤ r in ℝ and gives ∅ (differ: N = ℝ, p = 0, r = -1).
why: For r ≥ 0, ρ ≤ ofReal r ↔ (ρ ≠ ⊤ ∧ ρ.toReal ≤ r) (ENNReal.le_ofReal_iff_toReal_le), and ρ agrees (riemDist_eq). Negative radii are outside Milnor's use (S = {x : ρ(p,x) ≤ √c}).
